Hydroponics made EASY
with hydroponicsAI.

The future of agriculture.

Determine how healthy your hydroponic plants are

Upload an image of your plant and we'll compare it to our AI, trained on similar plants, and will determine whether your plant is healthy or not.

about our AI model and how it works

Our convolutional neural network(CNN) consists of 8 layers of pooling, convection, and condensing which processes and trains our model on a data set consisting of over 4 thousand instances of plants of varying health.
